name: Bharti Hexacom Ltd.
about: Bharti Hexacom Limited provides mobile services, fixed-line telephone, and broadband services to end consumers under the Airtel brand in India and internationally. It operates through Mobile Services; and Homes, Office and Other Services segments. The Mobile Services segment provides voice and data telecom services through wireless technology comprising 2G, 4G, and 5G networks; and offers intra-city fiber networks. The Home and Office Services segment offers voice and data communication services through fixed-line network and broadband technology for homes and offices. It also offers subscriptions for voice, data, messaging, and interconnection/roaming services, as well as other added value services. In addition, the company provides Connectivity and digital solutions for mobility, homes, business, as well as broadband, fixed-line, IPTV services. The company was formerly known as Hexacom

verdict.label: Around fair value
reasons: PE of 39 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 61), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 39 vs sector median 35; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 25, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
Since 2024, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 63% a year while PE moved 74 → 39.
